ph.quote: **surface pH increases from 5.2 to 6.5 during ripening**

ammonia.reason: NH3 from amino-acid deamination/decarboxylation by Brevibacterium linens and yeasts raising surface pH to 6.5.

animal_barnyard.reason: p-cresol, isovaleric acid and phenol from Tyr/Leu catabolism by Brevibacterium + Micrococcaceae smear.

bitter.reason: Hydrophobic bitter peptides from rennet/chymosin and plasmin proteolysis, incompletely degraded in 35-day age.

blue_moldy.reason: No Penicillium roqueforti inoculation, so no 2-heptanone/2-nonanone blue-ketone pathway.

browning.reason: Moderate Maillard/lactose-protein browning of high-moisture, deacidified paste when baked.

buttery.reason: Diacetyl/acetoin from citrate metabolism by Lactococcus lactis biovar diacetylactis starter.

cheesy_sweaty.reason: Butyric/hexanoic free fatty acids from lipolysis by yeasts, Geotrichum and Micrococcaceae lipases.

creaminess.reason: High moisture 49.4% + 26.7% fat with surface proteolysis liquefying paste under rind.

crumbliness.reason: Rennet-gelled, washed, surface-deacidified paste is supple and cohesive, not acid-crumbly.

firmness.reason: Soft washed-rind body from high moisture and extensive surface proteolysis, sliceable but yielding.

floral_honey.reason: Phenylacetaldehyde/2-phenylethanol from phenylalanine Strecker/Ehrlich by smear yeasts.

fruity.reason: Ethyl butanoate/hexanoate from ethanol + FFA esterification by Debaryomyces hansenii/Geotrichum.

goaty.reason: Cow milk low in 4-methyloctanoic/4-ethyloctanoic branched acids characteristic of goat.

malty_nutty.reason: 3-methylbutanal/2-methylbutanal from leucine/isoleucine Strecker plus pyrazines from rind washing.

melt.reason: Deacidified pH 5.8-6.5, high moisture and intact casein network flows readily on heating.

mushroom_earthy.reason: 1-octen-3-ol/1-octen-3-one from linoleic acid lipoxygenase by Geotrichum/Mucor surface flora.

oil_off.reason: Free oil release from 26.7% fat soft matrix on melting, limited by ~19% protein emulsion.

smoky.reason: No smoking step and no guaiacol/phenol from wood smoke.

sour_vinegar.reason: Residual L-lactic plus acetic acid from Lactobacillus/Streptococcus and surface heterofermenters.

stretch.reason: No pasta-filata hot-water kneading; weak calcium-phosphate depleted network gives only short extensibility.

sulfur_cooked.reason: Methanethiol/dimethyl sulfide-disulfide from methionine gamma-lyase in Brevibacterium linens.

sweet.reason: Low residual lactose/galactose plus glycerol and sweet amino acids Pro/Gly/Ala from proteolysis.

umami.reason: Free glutamate and 5'-nucleotides from rennet + plasmin proteolysis during smear ripening.
